description: This source file extends the 'AnyCodable' struct with helper computed properties to safely extract various types (String, Bool, Int, Double, Dictionary, Array) from its 'value' property, facilitating type-safe access and conversion.

methods.name: stringValue
methods.description: Returns the 'value' as a String if possible.

methods.name: boolValue
methods.description: Returns the 'value' as a Bool if possible, including NSNumber with boolean type.

methods.name: intValue
methods.description: Returns the 'value' as an Int if possible, handling NSNumber with non-boolean type.

methods.name: doubleValue
methods.description: Returns the 'value' as a Double if possible, converting from Int or NSNumber.

methods.name: dictionaryValue
methods.description: Returns the 'value' as a dictionary [String: AnyCodable] if possible, converting from other dictionary types.

methods.name: arrayValue
methods.description: Returns the 'value' as an array [AnyCodable] if possible, converting from other array types.

methods.name: foundationValue
methods.description: Returns a Foundation-compatible representation of the 'value', including nested dictionaries and arrays.
